method: Installed-source and actual-owned-command derivation; not an exposed live cache-config field

config/cache.py.fact: CacheConfig.block_size defaults to None; platform resolves the default

engine/arg_utils.py.fact: EngineArgs inherits the None default and passes its block_size into CacheConfig

platforms/cuda.py.fact: CUDA sets an unspecified cache block size to16; subsequent forced64/128 overrides are inside model_config.use_mla

config/__init__.py.fact: qwen3_moe is outside the DeepSeek/Eagle MLA types; is_deepseek_mla isFalse, so use_mla isFalse

platforms/__init__.py.fact: The built-in CUDA platform is selected for the installed GPU build; no external platform entrypoint is installed

v1/core/kv_cache_utils.py.fact: KV groups use CacheConfig.block_size; startup token capacity is the block count times the cache block size, not a sum of TP-rank capacities

entrypoints/openai/api_server.py.fact: The server_info development route exposes a configuration string only when development routes are enabled

limits: The observation is the then-live seq8 process, before the separately owned seq16 retune; it does not certify a future process identity
Recheck installed source hashes and absence of a CLI/platform override before the adaptive activation window
16-token admission rounding is single-worker accounting; this does not prove physical KV allocation or protect against another engine caller
